title: Send a notification email, paced, with retries, never tracked
description: **Reworked 2026-11-04:** Ryan reversed the architecture. No new AWS account and no central service; see docs/notifications-plan.md in AnthusAI/Caducus. **Milestone:** M1, first slice **Goal.** As an operator, I get a readable HTML and plain-text email with no pixel and no rewritten link. **Build.** - `channels/email.py`, `render/operator.py`, `handlers/email_sender.py`, behind a `Mailer` and a `Renderer` interface, so a host can pass its own (Papyrus: `email_render`). - Claim the row with `attribute_not_exists` before SES; backoff 1, 2, 4 seconds; pace to `MaxSendRate`, shared across a whole AWS account's senders, so backoff matters. - Inline styles, links underlined, state in words and a mark. Escape everything. Tags `delivery`, `kind`. **Acceptance.** Rendered samples checked by test for no `` pixel, no tracking host, a text part and the state as a word. **Depends on:** kanbus-ad0a0d **Related:** PPY-bf63d5 **Specification.** ```gherkin Feature: Email channel Scenario: An email goes out once Given a queued email delivery When the sender handles it twice Then SES was called once And the log shows "sent" with the provider id Scenario: SES throttles Given SES answers with a throttling error When the sender handles a delivery Then it retries with backoff and the delivery is still sent once Scenario: Nothing in the mail tracks the reader When any notification email is rendered Then it has no tracking image and every link points at its real destination ```
